name: Empty workspace selection sends a sentinel id
summary: None picked or attr filter matches none -> workspace_ids=[__no_workspace_matches_filters__]; all picked -> [] (= every workspace)

name: Filter and nav changes never push history
summary: HashState.write uses history.replaceState so filters/job panel do not add history entries

name: Tag filter: values OR within a name, names AND
summary: Empty values = any value (untagged left out); all=true narrows nothing and is dropped by narrowingTag

name: Window comes from meta
summary: Open on meta.open_window (else default_window) unless the hash names w=; unavailable windows hidden, partial labelled

name: Old tab/sub-tab links still land
summary: query->queries, lineage->governance/lineage, domains->findings; old sub-tab keys mapped unless now a live sub-tab

name: Committed dist must match web/ source
summary: source-hash meta written by vite plugin equals sha256 of tracked web/ files (LF), first 16 hex
